challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The feature store currently waits for a manual trigger before pushing data to the training pipeline, which adds unnecessary latency to the nightly cycle. I want that hand over to fire automatically the moment new scan lines and stock receipts land in storage. Every hour we save between data arrival and model retraining is time we can spend testing new weather features before the morning order window opens. The more frequently the pipeline can ingest fresh signals, the faster we can validate whether those features actually improve forecast accuracy for seasonal articles. I am happy to wire up the event listeners and storage hooks for this automation, provided we can agree on the trigger conditions. I see no reason to keep this step manual when the infrastructure is ready to handle it.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly links the automation to the goal of saving time for feature testing and improving forecast accuracy, indicating that increasing the frequency of this process would make them happier and aligns with their core performance needs.
